How to buy

  1. Email me what you'd like to order.
  2. I’ll reply within a day or two with an invoice ($30 flat shipping is included). Once you have it, the painting is on hold for you.
  3. Pay by Interac e-Transfer with the invoice number in the message. I’ll email your receipt and get it in the mail.
Shipping is within Canada only. Common questions are on the FAQ.
